items.title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 工具、开发者平台和工程提效」。原文摘要显示：Komdigi, Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA launch the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, bringing world-class AI infrastructure to Indonesia’s researchers and students and developers.
items.insightText: 优先找可复用的工程范式、组织实践和系统架构细节，低相关议题可直接跳过。

items.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
items.summary: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game…
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
